types.name: InputConfigManager

fields.name: initialised
fields.comment: high: Get 0x50287 MOV byte [0x1e455c],0; InitAndPreload 0x5067a MOV byte [EDI],1; Shutdown 0x50131 MOV byte [ECX],BL(0). No Xbox reader in scope. PS2 +0x0 int.

fields.name: currentConfigType
fields.comment: high: InputConfigManager::ConfigType (PS2 name): 0 Driving, 1 POV; Get stores 2 (GetCurrentConfig's 'current' sentinel). SetConfig 0x50730 stores arg1; InitAndPreload 0x5067d stores 0; GetCurrentConfig 0x50189 reads it when arg==2; RPlayerCamera::Cam

fields.name: currentConfig
fields.comment: high: Index into configInfos[type]. InitAndPreload loads [0]=[0x2445a4], [1]=[0x24451c] and resets >= numConfigs to 0; SetConfig 0x50735 stores arg2 unless it is -1; GetCurrentConfig returns [ECX+EAX*4+8].

fields.name: numConfigs
fields.comment: high: ParseMasterConfigFile 0x5036d ('Driving' N) and 0x503f8 ('POV' N), via atol; GetNumConfigs 0x50174 returns [ECX+i*4+0x10]; loop bound in Shutdown and InitAndPreload.

fields.name: configInfos
fields.comment: high: operator new[](N*0x5c) 0x114710 in ParseMasterConfigFile (stored 0x503ab/0x50431); operator delete[] 0x1146e0 in Shutdown 0x5011b; GetLocaleID, SetConfig and InitAndPreload index [+0x18+type*4] + idx*0x5c.

fields.name: inverted
fields.comment: high: SetInverted 0x50144 MOV [ECX+0x20],AL; IsInverted 0x50160 MOV AL,[ECX+0x20]; InitAndPreload 0x5069a = ([0x2445b4] != 0). Get does not initialise it (bss zero). PS2 +0x20 int.

fields.name: frontEndNameLookup
fields.comment: high: InitAndPreload 0x50612 = new StringToNumber(0x1b6f58) (FastAlloc 0x10 'StringToNumber'); used by ParseDefFileForFrontEnd 0x4ffe6; destroyed, FastFree'd (0x10) and zeroed at 0x5065c-0x50677. Get zeroes it (0x1e4580). Name invented.

fields.name: frontEndDefText
fields.comment: high: InitAndPreload 0x50520 = UFileLoader::FileLoad("data/Control/FrontEnd.def", 0); parsed first by every mapping load (InitAndPreload 0x506f3, SetConfig 0x50782); FileFree'd by Shutdown 0x500e2. Get zeroes it (0x1e4584). The earlier name 'masterFi

fields.name: unusedFileData
fields.comment: medium: Only Get (zeroes 0x1e4588) and Shutdown (FileFree if non-NULL, 0x500fd) touch it; nothing in scope writes it (the same on PS2). Name invented.

types.comment: Function-local static at 0x1e455c, guard dword 0x1e458c bit 0 (directly after the object, proving 0x30). Get 0x50270 inlines the PS2 constructor (PS2 0x166508) and registers no atexit. PS2 stores initialised/inverted as ints; Xbox writes and reads them as bytes.

types.name: ConfigInfo

fields.name: fileName
fields.comment: high: ParseMasterConfigFile 0x50454 copies the token byte by byte (an unbounded strcpy) to record+0; InitAndPreload appends it to "data/Control/" (0x5056e). Byte 0 zeroed at 0x5039c. The size is the distance to +0x20.

fields.name: defText
fields.comment: high: InitAndPreload 0x505a5 = FileLoad(path, 0); passed to ParseDefFileForFrontEnd (0x50633) and LoadParseDefFile (0x506d9, 0x50768); Shutdown FileFree's and zeroes it (0x500a5-0x500b9).

fields.name: frontEndLocaleIDs
fields.comment: high: Zeroed by REP STOSD with ECX=0xe from +0x24 (0x50395). ParseDefFileForFrontEnd 0x50005 stores atol(value) at +0x24+slot*4. GetLocaleID 0x501ba reads [rec + (idx*0x17+slot)*4 + 0x24]. Slots come from table 0x1b6f58: 0 ButtonA, 1 ButtonB, 2 Butto

types.comment: PS2 name (ParseDefFileForFrontEnd(ConfigInfo *, char *)). Arrays are allocated with operator new[](N*0x5c), with no cookie and no ctor: ParseMasterConfigFile zeroes fileName[0], defText and the 14 locale ids itself.

types.name: StringToNumber

fields.name: count
fields.comment: high: ctor 0x119f72 = the number of entries before the first NULL .string; dtor FastFree size count<<4; BinarySearch hi = count-1; bound of the linear search.

fields.name: table
fields.comment: high: ctor 0x119f74 = arg; the linear ConvertStringToNumber path 0x11a142.

fields.name: sortedByString
fields.comment: high: ctor 0x119f95 = the FastAlloc block, or 0 when count < 31 (0x119ffc); ConvertStringToNumber tests it to choose binary search (0x11a112) and returns [it+idx*8]; BinarySearch reads [+8]+idx*8+4; the dtor frees it.

fields.name: sortedByNumber
fields.comment: high: ctor 0x119f90 = block + count*8, sorted with 0x119f40; 0 when count < 31. Nothing in scope reads it (PS2 ConvertNumberToString/BinarySearch(int)).

types.comment: SupportPS2.lib UStringToNum. Built over a caller-owned StringToNumberEntry table ending in string==NULL. A table of 31 or more entries gets two sorted copies in one FastAlloc(count*16, "StringToNumber") block: one sorted by string (0x119ef0, strcmp on .string) and one by number (0x119f40, a.number - b.number). Smaller tables are searched linearly. Instances: 0x1e23e0 (actions, 0x1b6ba0, 117 entries, sorted), 0x1e4590 (update methods, 0x1b6fd0, 10 entries, linear), InputToAction::scalarNameLookup (20 pad scalars, linear), InputConfigManager::frontEndNameLookup (0x1b6f58, 14 entries, linear).

types.name: StringToNumberEntry

fields.name: number
fields.comment: high: ConvertStringToNumber returns [entry+0]; InputToAction ctor 0x508f3 stores i.

fields.name: string
fields.comment: high: The ctor counts until [entry+4]==0; the comparators and BinarySearch read +4.

types.comment: {number, string}. The table ends at the first entry whose string is NULL; that entry's number is ignored.

types.name: InputTable

fields.name: count
fields.comment: high: ctor 0; Reset 0x509a3 zeroes it; LoadParseDefFile INC [ESI] 0x50b6a; Grow copies count entries.

fields.name: capacity
fields.comment: high: ctor 4; Grow += 4 (0x507eb); LoadParseDefFile grows when count >= capacity (0x50b47); the dtor frees capacity*0xc.

fields.name: entries
fields.comment: high: ctor = this+0xc; Grow = FastAlloc(capacity*0xc, "TableEntries"); the dtor frees it if != this+0xc.

fields.name: inlineEntries
fields.comment: high: ctor LEA ECX,[EAX+0xc]; 0x3c-0xc = 4*0xc.

types.comment: Checked again: ctor 0x507a0, dtor 0x507c0, GrowArrayForOneElement 0x507e0, AddTableEntry inlined in LoadParseDefFile 0x50b31-0x50b6a, Clear inlined in InputToAction::Reset 0x50990.

fields.name: updateMethod
fields.comment: high: LoadParseDefFile 0x50b62 stores the method index (0..9, table 0x1b6fd0); the default is 0.

fields.name: threshold
fields.comment: high: 0x50b64: 0.5f (0x3f000000) for methods 3/4, otherwise 0, then overridden by sscanf("%f").

fields.name: action
fields.comment: high: 0x50b67: getActionID(first token), which is 0x75 when the name is unknown.

fields.name: numTables
fields.comment: high: ctor = device->GetNumDeviceScalar() (vtable slot 3); Reset loop bound.

fields.name: tables
fields.comment: high: operator new[](n*0x3c+4) with a count cookie at [-4]; LoadParseDefFile indexes tables + scalarIndex*0x3c.

fields.name: scalarNameLookup
fields.comment: high: FastAlloc(0x10, "StringToNumber") + ctor over scalarNames; LoadParseDefFile 0x50abb ConvertStringToNumber(scalar token).

fields.name: scalarNames
fields.comment: high: FastAlloc(n*8+8, "StringToNumberEntry"): {i, &device->scalars[i].name} (the inline char[32] at DeviceScalar+4), then {0, NULL}.
